cases.name: Amarriah CeAnna Smith
cases.about: She was a student at the Elizabeth City State University.
cases.narrative:
On 1/17/2024, a towing company employee found her body in the trunk of a car owned by Jordan Isaiah Thomas.

Her autopsy says Smith’s death was the result of a homicide but the cause is undetermined because her body had been burned, dismembered, and she was possibly shot. The medical examiner’s report says in addition to the car trunk, part of her remains were recovered from a burn pit.
